meta.title: Master source registry — all citations used across this project
meta.verification_method: Every URL below was opened and its content read on 2026-11-01 (UTC) via direct page fetch or full-content search result. No URL is included that was not checked on that date. Dynamic pages (odds boards, standings, injury reports) are cited as live official sources; snapshot values are recorded in league_facts.json with an as-of date.
meta.policy: Only official / first-party sources are used: the NFL and its official properties, licensed-sportsbook official help pages, state gaming regulators, NIST (US government statistics), Princeton University (hosting the original Kelly paper), Kaggle (official competition platform), NOAA/NWS, and the National Council on Problem Gambling. Third-party blogs are NOT used as sources; anything that could only be found there is left blank and listed in data/flagged.json.
meta.integration_note: Two independent registries were merged by the integration session (arena/70a33596-korea2): the SRC-* entries below were built by the sibling data/quant sessions, and the entries appended after them were opened and confirmed by the integration session for the published dashboard. Both sets were verified on 2026-11-01.
